articles.title: Jupiter Wagons among 8 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
articles.summary: Eight Nifty500 stocks, including Jupiter Wagons, Dabur India and Hindustan Unilever, featured on StockEdge's White Marubozu bullish scanner. The candlestick pattern indicates strong buying momentum, with stocks closing at or near their session highs.…
